columns.name: action_type
columns.declaration: action_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action_type IN ('backfill', 'rerun_dbt', 'create_ticket', 'post_notification'))

columns.name: requested_by
columns.declaration: requested_by TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(requested_by) BETWEEN 1 AND 200)

columns.name: reason
columns.declaration: reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(reason) BETWEEN 5 AND 2000)

columns.name: status
columns.declaration: status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected', 'cancelled'))

columns.name: version
columns.declaration: version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (version > 0)

columns.declaration: created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

columns.declaration: updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

columns.name: execution_status
columns.declaration: execution_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_started' CHECK (execution_status IN ('not_started', 'dispatching', 'dispatched', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'unknown'))

constraints.name: approval_decision_fields
constraints.sql: CHECK ( (status = 'pending' AND decided_at IS NULL) OR (status IN ('approved', 'rejected') AND decided_by IS NOT NULL AND decided_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status = 'cancelled' AND (decided_at IS NULL OR decided_by IS NOT NULL)) )

constraints.name: approval_claim_fields
constraints.sql: CHECK ( (execution_status = 'not_started' AND execution_run_id IS NULL) OR (status = 'approved' AND execution_run_id IS NOT NULL) )
